description: Peek at the operator message transcript without draining mail.

all_namespaces.description: Bypass namespace scoping and match across all namespaces.

include_system.description: Include system receipt metadata in the transcript.

namespace.description: Namespace slug to scope this tool. Overrides the caller session namespace fallback.

recipient.description:
Recipient selector used for matching mailboxes.

Grammar:
  all
  <uuid-or-prefix>
  id:<uuid>
  role:<name>
  namespace:<slug>
  dir:<path>
  label:<key>=<value>
  label:<key> in (v1, v2)
Examples:
  all
  019e44f9-...
  019e44f
  role:engineer
  namespace:default
  dir:/tmp/project
  label:app=nginx
  "label:app in (web, api)"

selector.description:
Participant selector used for matching messages.

Grammar:

  dir:<path>

Examples:

  019e44f
  role:engineer
  namespace:default
  dir:/tmp/project
  label:app=nginx

name: mail_peek
